operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S09. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S09_entry_watchlist: S09 is the formal roadmap section for exceptions and logging. Exception names and try/except/raise have appeared repeatedly since S02 but remain MENTION_ONLY; S09 must teach propagation, catch boundaries and process exit from first principles rather than saying 'as you already know'.

The strongest prior misconception to repair is S08-F19: catching ValueError and printing 'exit != 0' still produced actual process exit code 0. S09 must explicitly separate exception occurrence, exception handling and process exit status.
CSV dialect may be treated as USABLE from S08, but CSV logical-record accounting is MISCONCEPTION_RISK because S08 split physical lines before parsing quoted multiline fields.
Quarantine/reconciliation are only PARTIAL: S09 logging must not assume raw evidence format or n_in counting is settled.
JSON and JSONL remain PARTIAL because S08 theory did not demonstrate deserialization/JSONL round trips. Logging examples should not require JSON fluency without a bridge.
Path/encoding are PARTIAL and with remains MENTION_ONLY. S09 file/log examples should not hide exception pedagogy behind unmastered context-manager syntax unless it is microexplained.
SHA-256/provenance remain MISCONCEPTION_RISK: a digest identifies content, not source authenticity; backup/hash order in S08 can race.
sort_keys determinism remains unsafe: source-list order is not canonicalized by JSON key sorting.
Module/import mechanics remain MENTION_ONLY; S09 will necessarily import logging/traceback and must provide a bounded microdefinition.
Function definition/parameter binding remain PARTIAL from S05; avoid wrapping every first exception example in large helper functions.
CP-N1-B/CASO identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless expanded globally.
